issues.detail: The skill file lacks explicit handling for error scenarios such as authentication failures or missing project links.
The file contains extensive explanatory text that may be considered verbose for a skill file.
The skill assumes a Node.js environment and may not work on agents without Node.js support.

scenarios.name: deploy-feature-branch-preview
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully follows the rubric, while Response B omits the required git-branch flag, the exact deploy command, and the inspect step.

scenarios.name: rollback-production-after-500
scenarios.rationale: Response B includes all required Vercel commands; Response A only asks for more context and provides no commands.

scenarios.name: add-custom-domain-and-alias
scenarios.rationale: Response A uses Netlify commands and fails to meet the rubric, while Response B uses Vercel commands but does not include the exact alias command required by the rubric.
